definitions.explanation: The physical sensation or quality of being cold to the touch.
An unfriendly, distant, or emotionally cold attitude or manner.

examples.japanese: {氷|こおり}の{冷|つめ}たさを{感|かん}じた。
examples.english: I felt the coldness of the ice.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}の{冷|つめ}たさが{気持|きも}ちいい。
examples.english: The coldness of the water feels refreshing.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}の{朝|あさ}、{床|ゆか}の{冷|つめ}たさで{目|め}が{覚|さ}めた。
examples.english: I woke up from the coldness of the floor on a winter morning.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{態度|たいど}の{冷|つめ}たさに{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised by the coldness of his attitude.

examples.japanese: {別|わか}れた{後|あと}の{冷|つめ}たさが{辛|つら}かった。
examples.english: The coldness after the breakup was painful.

examples.japanese: {周|まわ}りの{人|ひと}の{冷|つめ}たさに{耐|た}えられなくなった。
examples.english: I could no longer bear the coldness of the people around me.

notes:
{冷|つめ}たさ is the noun form of the i-adjective {冷|つめ}たい, formed by replacing い with さ. Like the adjective, it can describe both physical cold and emotional coldness.

FORMS:
This follows the standard ～さ pattern for converting i-adjectives into nouns: {暑|あつ}い → {暑|あつ}さ, {高|たか}い → {高|たか}さ, {冷|つめ}たい → {冷|つめ}たさ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷|つめ}たさを{感|かん}じる: feel the coldness
- {冷|つめ}たさが{残|のこ}る: the coldness remains
- {冷|つめ}たさに{慣|な}れる: get used to the cold
- {態度|たいど}の{冷|つめ}たさ: the coldness of one's attitude

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {寒|さむ}さ: coldness (of weather/air) — used for ambient temperature; {冷|つめ}たさ is for touch or emotional coldness
- {冷|ひ}え: chill; cooling — the sensation of becoming cold, or coldness in the body
